final_message:
Implemented bounded SQLite lock hardening.

- Updated [app/service.py](/home/ricardo/Área%20de%20trabalho/codex-state-of-art-harness/projects/codex-harness/.p7-backend-builder-rerun-jvxm7hjs/pilot/app/service.py) to classify `SQLITE_BUSY` and `SQLITE_LOCKED`, including extended result codes, instead of relying solely on error text.
- Preserved the existing parameterized retry budget, backoff, transaction atomicity, idempotency, uniqueness constraints, and HTTP `409 CONFLICT` exhaustion contract.
- Added [test_sqlite_lock_retry.py](/home/ricardo/Área%20de%20trabalho/codex-state-of-art-harness/projects/codex-harness/.p7-backend-builder-rerun-jvxm7hjs/pilot/tests/test_sqlite_lock_retry.py), covering recovery from an opaque extended-code lock burst.
- No migration or schema changes were required.

Fixed host observer: **29 passed in 3.53s**.

Limitation: retries remain deliberately bounded; sustained contention still returns the documented busy conflict response. No release or security approval is implied.
